detail.longDescription:
I think I've asked this one before, or a similar question, but I'm hopeful of getting more #poll responses. This is a #programming question pertaining to GUI toolkits used for implementing graphical applications in a hopefully portable way.

I am curious as to what folks might have actually tried using themselves, either on some UNIX platform or Windows (or other!). Multiple-choice.

[ ] GTK
[ ] Qt
[ ] FLTK
[ ] FOX
[ ] wxWidgets
[ ] tk
[ ] none (e.g. plain X11 apps)
[ ] graphics are bad
[ ] other toolkits (specify)
